answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance and efficiency of TokenSelect on three representative long-context benchmarks using three open-source LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include summaries, answers to questions, code debugging responses, mathematical reasoning, and retrieval-based responses as part of long-context inference evaluation across multiple tasks in the benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: For InfiniteBench , we use longbook_sum_eng (En.Sum), longbook_qa_eng (En.QA), longbook_choice_eng (En.MC), longdi-alogue_qa_eng (En.Dia), code_debug (Code.D), math_find (Math.F), passkey (R.PK), num-ber_string (R.Num) and kv_retrieval (R.KV) as evaluation datasets.
